## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0da1e7d55fb2f552c90bc78e61574a419962270d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/types/src/field-types.ts, ui/packages/types/src/index.ts, ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/field-metadata-family-retired-12242.test.ts + ui/packages/types/package.json (`exports`), ui/packages/types/src/form.ts, ui/packages/types/src/views.ts, ui/packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts, ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts, ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GeolocationField.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts, .changeset/config.json, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs (`readFromBlock`, read only), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, AGENTS.md l.1020–1034

Record time: 2026-11-08T01:24Z. Inputs: card #25921 body and all 133 comments (claim 6714769871, amendment 6714801527, dev report 6715508014, the batch 8–12 rules in 6703671714 and the batch-12 record 6704431558 as precedent), PR #31316 body, file list and net diff against the merge base `7c523aa1`, the check-runs on the head. Every absence claim below was re-measured by this seat on `origin/main` `57675a21` (six commits past the PR base, none of them touching `ui/packages/types/**` or a `25921-*` changeset; `git merge-tree` of the head onto it is clean) and on hotcrm `6961ab1`, with `git grep -w` over the whole tree, CHANGELOGs excluded.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Diff is exactly the amendment's four edits.** One commit, 4 files, +37/−37: the two declarations leave `field-types.ts` (each replaced by a `//` note naming the live replacement), both names leave the "Field Types" list in `index.ts` (plus a `//` note), the `FieldMetadata` union comment and the 12242 pin's JSDoc l.36 stop naming the retired interface, and one new changeset. No other path; nothing fenced is touched (no `types/src/ai.ts`, no subpath entry, no `packages/**`, no pending `25921-*` changeset, no `Spec*` alias). Right.
- **Public-surface change: the `@object-ui/types` root entry loses two type-only names; no subpath is affected.** The `exports` map has twelve entries; none re-exports `field-types.ts` with `export *` — `form.ts` and `views.ts` import only `GridFieldMetadata` and `SelectOptionMetadata` by name, `zod/form.zod.ts` only `GRID_FIELD_RETIRED_KEYS`. A `type` alias and an `interface` emit no JavaScript, so `dist/*.js` is unchanged. Right.
- **Zero readers outside the declaring module, re-measured.** On `origin/main` `57675a21`: `VisibilityCondition` hits `field-types.ts` (declaration + two self-references) and `index.ts` only; `GeolocationFieldMetadata` hits those two plus the 12242 pin's JSDoc l.36, a prose line with no assertion behind it. `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/**`, the types README, every `*.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/**`, `.changeset/*` and the shadcn/export fixtures: 0. The only CHANGELOG hits are the objectui#12242 release notes (`ui/packages/types/CHANGELOG.md` l.1476, l.1516), which record the earlier FROM → TO and teach nothing as current. At head the names survive only in `//` notes and the changeset. Right.
- **hotcrm: 0 hits for both, but the control is vacuous.** hotcrm `6961ab1` imports `@object-ui/types` in 0 files (8 files name any `@object-ui/*` package). The absence is true and the rule is met; it just carries no evidential weight for this package. Informational, not a finding.
- **No kept export reaches either name.** `BaseFieldMetadata.visible_on` is a `never` tombstone (main l.160), not `VisibilityCondition`; `visibleWhen` is `SpecField['visibleWhen']` (main l.149). `FieldMetadata` has had no `geolocation` arm since objectui#12242 (main l.1507–1508); nothing `extends GeolocationFieldMetadata`. A shape search for the alias's `operator?: '=' | '!=' …` union finds only the deleted alias. Right.
- **The `field:geolocation` widget never depended on the interface.** `GeolocationField` takes `FieldWidgetComponentProps` whose `field` is `FieldMetadata` (`fields/src/widgets/types.ts` l.136); every `type: 'geolocation'` literal in the fields tests is cast (`as any`, `Record` of unknown). The lazy registration (`fields/src/index.tsx` l.4876, l.5110) and the alias row (`field-type-alias.ts` l.168) are untouched by the diff, so the changeset's "widget stays registered" sentence is true of the tree. Right.
- **The test edit weakens no pin.** At head the 12242 pin still refuses `type: 'geolocation'` against `FieldMetadata` through `@ts-expect-error` (l.260–264) and still refuses `visible_on` as an inline object literal against `never` (l.105–106, l.295) — neither names a retired type, so both keep firing after the deletion. Right.
- **Positive controls hold in the same module.** `FieldMetadata` is read by `fields/src/widgets/types.ts` l.136 (and dozens more); `LocationFieldMetadata` is declared (main l.839), in the union (l.1492), and read by the pin (l.53, l.151). Right.
- **ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` ×2, read by hand against the gate's own reader.** One marker in the changeset body, category `runtime-export-retired`, operands `@object-ui/types#VisibilityCondition` and `@object-ui/types#GeolocationFieldMetadata`. The body has exactly two `- FROM … TO …` lines, each with one code span between the words, so `readFromBlock` yields two FROM sides, 1:1 with the operands. P1: both are exported from the base barrel and declared at base, absent from both at head. P2: no metadata surface names either. The CI gate run is the machine confirmation (it sits inside "Lint · repo & tooling gates", success).
- **Declarations are well-formed and agree.** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset. `reviewFace` over the four paths decides no face and defers to that `Clause-②:` line, so the narrowing face is the right one and `hits` is empty; the Scope floor above is every non-prose path of the diff.
- **Check-runs on the head at 2026-11-08T01:22Z: 54 runs, 36 completed (25 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure), 18 in progress** — the 16 `Test UI` shards, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`. Completed successes include Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, every `Lint ·` family including repo & tooling gates and PM dispatch-gates, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate and Test Core. Not waited on.

### ② Semver level

`patch` is right. The change moves nothing a metadata author can write: `FieldSchema` already refuses `geolocation` at `type` (the `FieldType` enum, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` l.49–121, has `location` at l.58 and no `geolocation`) and refuses `visible_on` by name, and the union and the tombstone made both refusals real in `@object-ui/types` at objectui#12242. So `Metadata-protocol: none`, which takes `patch` (AGENTS.md l.1027–1028: "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition"). `@object-ui/types` is in the `fixed` group and `check-changeset-no-major` forbids `major` in the launch window. The changeset carries `!`, **BREAKING**, FROM → TO per name with the one-line fix (`visibleWhen`; `location` / `LocationFieldMetadata`), the single ADR-0087 marker and both declaration lines — the same level and disposition as batches 8–12 on this package (precedent 6704431558). Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` — right, the PR declares the narrowing and nothing widens.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6715508014: `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`. Nothing to escalate.
- Deviations declared, each answered: `Part of #25921` instead of `Fixes` — the claim itself orders "The PR says `Part of #25921`" and the card keeps options B, C and the seven `Spec*` aliases open; no labels on `pr_create` — the order named none (Auto Label applied `documentation`, `size/s`, `tests`, `tooling`); detached shared checkout for the worktree — process, not tree.
- Fences hold: no governed surface, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no `.claude/skills/**`, head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (not a fork), Governed Surface Queue Guard success.
- The PR is a draft with `mergeable_state: blocked`, which is the expected state before this record and the still-running UI shards; not a flag.
- Informational: the hotcrm leg of the census proves nothing for `@object-ui/types` (0 importers of the package there); the workspace leg is what carries the absence claim, and it holds.

### ④ Design judgment

Read against the published spec on `main`, the narrowing makes the spec's own refusal real rather than taking a declared capability away:

- `GeolocationFieldMetadata` declared `type: 'geolocation'`, a value `FieldType` does not contain and `FieldSchema` refuses with `invalid_value`; no published object can carry it, and the authoring union stopped offering it at objectui#12242 (ruling A, FROM → TO in the 12242 CHANGELOG). A host that annotated a literal with it on `main` got a type that compiled and a document the publish door rejects — a promise nothing could deliver. The spec's map point is `location`, typed by `LocationFieldMetadata`, which the FROM → TO names. The one live `geolocation` surface, the `field:geolocation` widget, is keyed by string and typed by `FieldMetadata`, and is untouched. The `'geolocation'` token in `packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts` l.86 is a display-name helper's "not a title" list, not a `FieldType` member — no declared capability sits behind it.
- `VisibilityCondition` typed the `{ field, operator, value }` object for `visible_on`, a key the spec refuses by name ("did you mean `visibleWhen`?") and `BaseFieldMetadata` types `never`; the form builders read predicate text only (field-types.ts main l.152–158; `plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` l.1131), so the object shape was never drawn as a gate. The live capability is `visibleWhen`, a CEL predicate typed by reference to the spec, which the FROM → TO names.

Tried to break it: no alias, shim or `@deprecated` re-export is left behind (consistent with batches 8–12: the names leave the module, not only the entry, and the `//` notes do not ship in the `.d.ts`); no in-package test loses a control; the 12242 pin's two round-two assertions keep firing without naming either type; no subpath or zod mirror ever reached them; the hotcrm consumer set is empty for the package. The only external exposure is a host importing either type by name, which the changeset declares BREAKING with the fix beside it. No must-fix, no should-fix.

**VERDICT: PASS**
